chat.text: I'm trying to decide between using Node.js or Go for a high-performance logic loop that handles a lot of heavy iterations. I know Go is generally faster, but I need a real-world comparison to see if the performance gap is actually significant enough to justify the switch in my specific use case. Could you provide a concrete comparison of the execution speed for a standard tight loop between the two? I'm looking for actual timing data rather than just theoretical complexity.
